meta.title: `update_egli` is refused outside evaluation time
gaps: act 1: PATCH /event_groups/update_egli is sent with no body — a request step carries the body the case writes (or a library/operation step has a working one)

words.preconditions: A fresh RFP + RFQ event where the invited QA vendor submitted its technical response, and both windows are over (evaluation time).
steps: The buyer sends the request that updates (and publishes) the event, the request the case itself writes.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You can update evaluators only in evaluation time.”, and never with a server error.

expected.message: You can update evaluators only in evaluation time.
